description: This file contains functions related to quantization of pitch and codebook gains for the AMR speech codec, specifically for the MR475 mode. It includes gain quantization, predictor updates, and gain storage functions, with references to standard tables and external functions for logarithmic and power calculations.

methods.name: MR475_gain_quant
methods.description: Performs quantization of pitch and codebook gains for two subframes using predicted gains, updating predictor states and returning the quantization index.

methods.name: MR475_update_unq_pred
methods.description: Updates the unquantized gain predictor with the prediction error based on the optimal codebook gain.

methods.name: MR475_quant_store_results
methods.description: Calculates the final fixed codebook gain, updates the gain predictor, and stores the quantized gains for a subframe.
